description: `prose last` (no `cli`) exits 2 with `cli run list --limit 1`; nothing is forwarded or billed.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: Unknown command.
Detail: `last` is not a command; did you mean `prose cli run list --limit 1`? `cli run list --limit 1` shows the latest run and `cli run show RUN_ID` one run. Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
Action: Use `cli run list`: `prose cli run list --limit 1`.
